note: Hand-typed cases for the typed-list format (M8.8, W13). Symbols are made up. A problem is [line, kind, text, other line].

parse.name: the as-of header is read
parse.text:
# a comment
# as of 2026-09-30
AAA
BBB

parse.name: a file with no header reads date not recorded
the header may be written in capitals and with spaces
a bad line is named by its number and left out
parse.text:
# as of 2026-09-30
AAA
ab cd
lower
BBB

parse.name: a duplicate is named and the first kept
a comment may follow a symbol, blank lines and a byte order mark are fine
a date that is not a date records no date and is named
an empty file is an empty list
